functions.name: cipherbird_blake2b_keyed
functions.doc: BLAKE2b with a caller-chosen output length, computed natively at that length (BLAKE2b's output length is a parameter, so this differs from a truncated cipherbird_blake2b), for keyed digests and PASERK identifiers. For PASETO tokens use cipherbird_paseto_v4_local_encrypt and _decrypt. out_len: 1 to 64. key_len: 0 (unkeyed, key may be NULL) or 16 to 64. msg may be NULL only when msg_len is 0. Any other length, or a NULL pointer with a non-zero length, fails closed with an error and no buffer. On success buf holds exactly out_len bytes, malloc'd by the library and written in place (no intermediate copy, no page locking); the caller owns it and must release it with cipherbird_buffer_free(), which wipes it. On error free the message with cipherbird_str_free().

functions.doc: XChaCha20-Poly1305 decrypt. Input must include nonce prefix.

functions.name: cipherbird_paseto_v4_local_encrypt_len
functions.doc: Exact length of the v4.local token cipherbird_paseto_v4_local_encrypt writes for a msg_len-byte message and a footer_len-byte footer, or 0 when either exceeds CIPHERBIRD_PASETO_V4_MAX_INPUT_BYTES.

functions.name: cipherbird_paseto_v4_local_decrypt_cap
functions.doc: Output capacity cipherbird_paseto_v4_local_decrypt requires for a token of token_len bytes. It depends only on the length (about 3/4 of it) and is 0 for a length no valid token has; decrypt then reports the token invalid.

functions.name: cipherbird_paseto_v4_local_encrypt
functions.doc: PASETO v4.local encrypt (PASETO v4 specification): a fresh 32-byte nonce from libsodium's CSPRNG, Ek and n2 from 56-byte keyed BLAKE2b, Ak from 32-byte keyed BLAKE2b, XChaCha20, and a 32-byte keyed BLAKE2b tag over PAE("v4.local.", n, c, footer, implicit). Writes the token text (ASCII, not NUL-terminated) to out and its length to out_len. key_len must be 32. msg, footer and implicit may be NULL only with a zero length and may each be up to CIPHERBIRD_PASETO_V4_MAX_INPUT_BYTES. out_cap must be at least cipherbird_paseto_v4_local_encrypt_len(msg_len, footer_len) and out must overlap no input. An empty footer is omitted from the token; implicit is authenticated but never stored. Returns CIPHERBIRD_PASETO_OK, CIPHERBIRD_PASETO_ERR_ARGUMENT or CIPHERBIRD_PASETO_ERR_INTERNAL; out_len is 0 on any failure. Allocates nothing; derived keys are on the stack and wiped before return.

functions.name: cipherbird_paseto_v4_local_decrypt
functions.doc: PASETO v4.local decrypt. Checks the "v4.local." header, decodes the body and footer as canonical unpadded base64url only, requires the token's footer to equal expected_footer exactly (an empty expected_footer means the token must carry none), verifies the tag in constant time and only then decrypts. Writes the message to out and its length to out_len. key_len must be 32. token, expected_footer and implicit may be NULL only with a zero length; out may be NULL only when out_cap is 0. out_cap must be at least cipherbird_paseto_v4_local_decrypt_cap(token_len) and out must overlap no input. Returns CIPHERBIRD_PASETO_OK; CIPHERBIRD_PASETO_ERR_INVALID for every failure that depends on the token (format, header, encoding, footer, length, tag), with no further detail; CIPHERBIRD_PASETO_ERR_ARGUMENT for a caller error that does not (key length, pointers, out_cap, oversize expected_footer or implicit); or CIPHERBIRD_PASETO_ERR_INTERNAL. On any failure out_len is 0 and the first decrypt_cap bytes of out are zero. Allocates nothing; derived keys are on the stack and wiped.

functions.name: cipherbird_blake2b_keyed_into
functions.doc: cipherbird_blake2b_keyed written straight into out (out_len bytes, 1 to 64) with the same argument rules, so a short keyed digest costs one call and no allocation. Returns CIPHERBIRD_PASETO_OK, CIPHERBIRD_PASETO_ERR_ARGUMENT (a bad length or a NULL pointer with a non-zero length) or CIPHERBIRD_PASETO_ERR_INTERNAL; out is zeroed on failure.

functions.name: cipherbird_cb1_local_encrypt_len
functions.doc: Exact length of the cb1.local token for a msg_len-byte message and a footer_len-byte footer, or 0 when either exceeds the maximum.

functions.name: cipherbird_cb1_local_decrypt_cap
functions.doc: Output capacity cipherbird_cb1_local_decrypt requires for a token of token_len bytes; 0 for a length no valid token has.

functions.name: cipherbird_cb1_local_encrypt
functions.doc: cb1.local encrypt; the contract of cipherbird_paseto_v4_local_encrypt.

functions.name: cipherbird_cb1_local_decrypt
functions.doc: cb1.local decrypt; the contract of cipherbird_paseto_v4_local_decrypt: header, canonical base64url, footer and tag (in constant time) are all checked before anything is decrypted, every token-dependent failure is CIPHERBIRD_PASETO_ERR_INVALID, and the output region is zero on failure.

functions.name: cipherbird_cb1_public_sign_len
functions.doc: Exact length of the cb1.public token for a msg_len-byte message and a footer_len-byte footer, or 0 when either exceeds the maximum.

functions.name: cipherbird_cb1_public_verify_cap
functions.doc: Output capacity cipherbird_cb1_public_verify requires for a token of token_len bytes; 0 for a length no valid token has.

functions.name: cipherbird_cb1_public_sign
functions.doc: cb1.public sign with a 4096-byte hybrid secret key. Writes the token text to out; out_cap must be at least cipherbird_cb1_public_sign_len. The footer is appended in clear and signed; implicit is signed but never stored. Returns CIPHERBIRD_PASETO_OK, CIPHERBIRD_PASETO_ERR_ARGUMENT or CIPHERBIRD_PASETO_ERR_INTERNAL; out_len is 0 on failure.

functions.name: cipherbird_cb1_public_verify
functions.doc: cb1.public verify with a 1984-byte hybrid public key. Checks the header, the encoding and the footer, then both signature halves over PAE("cb1.public.", m, expected_footer, implicit), and writes the message to out only when everything verifies. Every token-dependent failure is CIPHERBIRD_PASETO_ERR_INVALID; the output region is zero on failure.

functions.name: cipherbird_token_formats
functions.doc: The format table as a JSON array, one object per format with "format", "purpose" ("local" or "public"), "standard" ("PASETO v4" or "library-native"), "key_bytes", "public_key_bytes", "secret_key_bytes", "signature_bytes", "max_input_bytes" and "available". Writes the text (not NUL-terminated) to out when out_cap holds it and returns the length the full text needs, so a call with out_cap 0 sizes the buffer.

functions.name: cipherbird_token_issue_len
functions.doc: Exact token length the format produces for a payload_len-byte payload and a footer_len-byte footer; 0 for an unknown or unavailable format or a length over the format's maximum. format is NUL-terminated ASCII.

functions.name: cipherbird_token_accept_cap
functions.doc: Output capacity cipherbird_token_accept requires for a token of token_len bytes; 0 for an unknown or unavailable format or a length no valid token of that format has.

functions.name: cipherbird_token_keygen
functions.doc: A fresh key for the format: a local format writes key_bytes of CSPRNG output to secret and sets pub_len to 0 (pub may be NULL with pub_cap 0, pub_len may be NULL); a public format writes the secret half to secret and the public half to pub. Capacities come from the table. Returns CIPHERBIRD_TOKEN_OK, CIPHERBIRD_TOKEN_ERR_FORMAT, _UNAVAILABLE, _ARGUMENT (a NULL with a non-zero capacity, a capacity below the key size) or _INTERNAL; both lengths are 0 on any failure.

functions.name: cipherbird_token_issue
functions.doc: Issues a token: encrypts payload (local; key is the shared key) or signs it (public; key is the secret half). Writes the token text (ASCII, not NUL-terminated) to out and its length to out_len. The argument rules are those of cipherbird_paseto_v4_local_encrypt: NULL only with a zero length, inputs up to the format's maximum, out_cap at least cipherbird_token_issue_len, out overlapping no input, an empty footer omitted, implicit authenticated but never stored. Returns CIPHERBIRD_TOKEN_OK, CIPHERBIRD_TOKEN_ERR_FORMAT, _UNAVAILABLE, _ARGUMENT or _INTERNAL; out_len is 0 on any failure.

functions.name: cipherbird_token_accept
functions.doc: Accepts a token: decrypts it (local) or verifies it (public; key is the public half) and writes the payload to out. The token's header must be the named format; any other header is invalid, decided before the key is used, so the header inside a token never chooses the algorithm. Returns CIPHERBIRD_TOKEN_OK; CIPHERBIRD_TOKEN_ERR_INVALID for every token-dependent failure (header, base64url, length, tag or signature, footer), with no further detail; _FORMAT, _UNAVAILABLE, _ARGUMENT (a caller error that does not depend on token content) or _INTERNAL. On any failure out_len is 0 and out holds no plaintext.

functions.name: cipherbird_token_peek_format
functions.doc: The header of token as a format name ("cb1.local"), UNVERIFIED: writes it (not NUL-terminated) to out when out_cap holds it and returns its length, or 0 when the text does not start with <version>.<local|public>. The name need not be a format this engine knows; nothing it says is trusted until cipherbird_token_accept succeeds with that format.

functions.name: cipherbird_token_peek_footer
functions.doc: The decoded footer of token, UNVERIFIED, for choosing a key by its id. Writes the bytes to out and the length to out_len (0 when the token has no footer). Returns CIPHERBIRD_TOKEN_OK; _INVALID when the text has no header of the known shape or the footer is not base64url; _ARGUMENT when out is too small (about 3/4 of the footer text). The footer accept compares is the caller's expected_footer, never the one read here.

functions.name: cipherbird_noise_remote_static

functions.name: cipherbird_noise_encrypt

functions.name: cipherbird_noise_decrypt
functions.doc: Decrypt one transport record (after split).

functions.name: cipherbird_noise_decrypt_at
functions.doc: Decrypt the transport record that was sent at `nonce_counter`, without advancing the session's own counter. Records are sealed under (key, counter), so once a receiver knows a record's counter it can open that record on its own. This exists so a receiver can open several records at once: `cipherbird_noise_decrypt` is serial only because it owns the counter. Re-entrant - safe to call concurrently on ONE handle, because it does not mutate the session. CALLER'S DUTY, and the library cannot check any of it: - Assign each record the counter its sender used, counting from 0 in arrival order for that direction. - Open each counter at most once and reassemble plaintexts in order. Statelessly, a replayed record is indistinguishable from a fresh one; ordering and single-use are the caller's to enforce. - Do NOT mix this with `cipherbird_noise_encrypt`/`_decrypt` on the same handle concurrently: those mutate the session, and a concurrent mutation alongside this is a data race. There is deliberately no explicit-nonce ENCRYPT counterpart. Sealing twice under one (key, counter) leaks the XOR of both plaintexts and the Poly1305 one-time key, which yields forgery; nonce choice stays inside the library where it cannot repeat. Opening carries no such risk - the tag binds the counter, so a record only authenticates under the counter its sender actually used.

functions.name: cipherbird_session_handshake
functions.doc: The handshake message an initiator session must send (empty on a responder).

functions.name: cipherbird_session_accept
functions.doc: Responder: accept an incoming handshake with your prekey (public + secret).

functions.name: cipherbird_session_encrypt
functions.doc: Encrypt the next outgoing message (advances the sending ratchet).

functions.name: cipherbird_session_decrypt
functions.doc: Decrypt an incoming message (handles ratchet turns + out-of-order; transactional).

functions.name: cipherbird_session_free
functions.doc: Free a session handle.

functions.name: cipherbird_ml_dsa_keygen

functions.name: cipherbird_ml_dsa_sign
functions.doc: ML-DSA sign. Returns detached signature.

functions.name: cipherbird_ml_dsa_verify
functions.doc: ML-DSA verify. Returns 1 if valid, 0 if not.

functions.name: cipherbird_slh_dsa_keygen
functions.doc: SLH-DSA keygen. level: 0=128s,1=128f,2=192s,3=192f,4=256s,5=256f. hash: 0=SHA2,1=SHAKE.

functions.doc: SLH-DSA sign. Returns signature.

functions.name: cipherbird_slh_dsa_verify
functions.doc: SLH-DSA verify. Returns 1 if valid, 0 if not.

functions.name: cipherbird_bls_keygen

functions.name: cipherbird_bls_keygen_from_ikm
functions.doc: BLS keygen from IKM (deterministic). ikm must be >= 32 bytes. A shorter or null ikm returns an empty pair (both buffers NULL, length 0) with no error text; callers must check the lengths.

functions.name: cipherbird_bls_sign
functions.doc: BLS sign. Returns 96-byte compressed G2 signature.

functions.name: cipherbird_bls_verify
functions.doc: BLS verify. Returns 1 if valid, 0 if not.

functions.name: cipherbird_bls_aggregate
functions.doc: BLS aggregate N signatures into 1. sigs = array of 96-byte signatures.

functions.name: cipherbird_bls_aggregate_verify
functions.doc: BLS aggregate verify. msgs/pks = arrays of messages/public keys.

functions.name: cipherbird_frost_keygen_free
functions.doc: Free a CryptoFrostKeyGen (zeroises secret shares).

functions.name: cipherbird_frost_commit_free
functions.doc: Free a CryptoFrostCommit (zeroises nonces).

functions.name: cipherbird_frost_keygen
functions.doc: keygen(n,t): split a random group key into n shares, any t of which sign.

functions.name: cipherbird_frost_commit
functions.doc: Round 1: fresh random nonce pair + public commitment for a share.

functions.name: cipherbird_frost_commit_with_nonces
functions.doc: Deterministic round-1 commit from caller-supplied nonces (test vectors).

functions.name: cipherbird_frost_sign
functions.doc: Round 2: this participant's 32-byte signature share.

functions.name: cipherbird_frost_aggregate
functions.doc: Aggregate `count` signature shares to one 64-byte Ed25519 signature.

functions.name: cipherbird_frost_verify
functions.doc: Verify an aggregate signature with standard Ed25519. Returns 1/0.

functions.name: cipherbird_frost_verify_share
functions.doc: Verify one participant's signature share. Returns 1 valid, 0 invalid.

functions.name: cipherbird_hpke_keygen
functions.doc: Random X25519 key pair (pk 32 B, sk 32 B) for HPKE.

functions.name: cipherbird_hpke_derive_keypair
functions.doc: Deterministic DHKEM(X25519).DeriveKeyPair from input keying material.

functions.name: cipherbird_hpke_setup_s
functions.doc: Sender setup. On success returns a context handle and writes the KEM encapsulation to out_enc (free with cipherbird_buffer_free). On failure returns NULL and sets out_error (free with cipherbird_str_free).

functions.name: cipherbird_hpke_setup_r
functions.doc: Receiver setup. Returns a context handle, or NULL + out_error on failure.

functions.name: cipherbird_hpke_seal
functions.doc: Sender: AEAD-seal the next message (advances the context sequence).

functions.name: cipherbird_hpke_open
functions.doc: Receiver: AEAD-open the next message (advances the context sequence).

functions.name: cipherbird_hpke_export
functions.doc: Derive a `length`-byte secret bound to this context (RFC 9180 5.3).

functions.name: cipherbird_hpke_context_free
functions.doc: Release an HPKE context (zeroises its key material).

functions.name: cipherbird_ecvrf_keygen
functions.doc: Fresh Ed25519-style key pair (pk 32 B, sk = 32-byte seed).

functions.name: cipherbird_ecvrf_public_key
functions.doc: Derive the public key Y = x.B from a 32-byte secret seed.

functions.name: cipherbird_ecvrf_prove
functions.doc: Prove: returns the 80-byte proof pi for (sk, alpha).

functions.name: cipherbird_ecvrf_proof_to_hash
functions.doc: proof_to_hash: returns the 64-byte VRF output beta for a proof.

functions.name: cipherbird_ecvrf_verify
functions.doc: Verify: returns the 64-byte beta on success, or an error if the proof is invalid (check .error).

functions.name: cipherbird_bbs_keygen
functions.doc: BBS KeyGen from key material (>= 32 B) + optional key info. pk 96 B, sk 32 B. Returns an empty key pair (data=NULL) on failure.

functions.name: cipherbird_bbs_sk_to_pk
functions.doc: Derive the 96-byte public key from a 32-byte secret key.

functions.name: cipherbird_bbs_sign
functions.doc: Sign a vector of messages to 80-byte signature.

functions.name: cipherbird_bbs_verify
functions.doc: Verify a signature over a vector of messages. Returns 1 valid, 0 invalid.

functions.name: cipherbird_bbs_proof_gen
functions.doc: Derive a selective-disclosure proof. `msgs` is the FULL signed vector; `disclosed_indexes` (uint64, 0-based) selects which to reveal. An index out of range, a repeated index or a signature that does not decode is an error.

functions.name: cipherbird_bbs_proof_verify
functions.doc: Verify a selective-disclosure proof. `disclosed_msgs` are the revealed messages, aligned with `disclosed_indexes`. Returns 1 valid, 0 invalid.

functions.name: cipherbird_bbs_commit_with_nym
functions.doc: Holder: commit to committed_messages + prover_nyms (scalars the issuer must not learn). Returns commitment_with_proof; secret_prover_blind (32 B) via the out-param - the holder keeps it to finalize/prove later.

functions.name: cipherbird_bbs_blind_sign_with_nym
functions.doc: Issuer: blind-sign over the commitment + own messages, adding signer_nym_entropy to the last nym slot. Returns an 80-byte signature. The commitment's proof of knowledge is verified first; a malformed or forged commitment, a key of the wrong size or entropy that is not 32 bytes returns an error and signs nothing.

functions.name: cipherbird_bbs_finalize_nym_secrets
functions.doc: Holder: nym_secrets = prover_nyms with the last element += signer_nym_entropy. Returns the concatenated 32-byte scalars.

functions.name: cipherbird_bbs_calculate_pseudonym
functions.doc: Deterministic pseudonym for a context from the nym_secrets. Returns a compressed G1 point (48 B).

functions.name: cipherbird_bbs_proof_gen_with_pseudonym
functions.doc: Holder: generate a pseudonym-bound selective-disclosure proof. Returns the proof; the pseudonym (48 B) via the out-param. disclosed_ _indexes select the revealed signer / committed messages (each list 0-based into its own vector). The secret prover blind and every nym secret must be 32 bytes, at least one nym secret is required, and an index out of range, a repeated index or a signature that does not decode is an error.

functions.name: cipherbird_bbs_proof_verify_with_pseudonym
functions.doc: Verifier: check a pseudonym-bound proof. `disclosed_msgs`/`disclosed_indexes` are the COMBINED signer+committed disclosures (committed index j passed as j + L + 1). Returns 1 valid, 0 invalid.

functions.name: cipherbird_oprf_derive_keypair
functions.doc: OPRF key pair from a seed (+ optional info). pk 32 B, sk 32 B. Empty on error.

functions.name: cipherbird_oprf_blind_free
functions.doc: Free a CryptoOprfBlind (zeroises the blind).

functions.name: cipherbird_oprf_blind
functions.doc: Client: blind an input with a fresh random scalar.

functions.name: cipherbird_oprf_blind_with_scalar
functions.doc: Deterministic blind with a caller-supplied 32-byte scalar (test vectors).

functions.name: cipherbird_oprf_blind_evaluate
functions.doc: Server: evaluate a blinded element under the secret key to evaluated element.

functions.name: cipherbird_oprf_finalize
functions.doc: Client: unblind the evaluated element to 64-byte PRF output.

functions.name: cipherbird_oprf_evaluate
functions.doc: Server one-shot: compute the PRF output directly from the key + input.

functions.name: cipherbird_opaque_registration_request
functions.doc: Client registration step 1: blind the password. Returns {blind, request} in a CryptoOprfBlind (send blinded_element as the request; keep blind).

functions.name: cipherbird_opaque_registration_response
functions.doc: Server registration step: to 64-byte registration response.

functions.name: cipherbird_opaque_finalize_request
functions.doc: Client registration step 2: to record + export_key.

functions.name: cipherbird_opaque_client_init
functions.doc: Client login step 1: to KE1 + client_state.

functions.name: cipherbird_opaque_server_respond
functions.doc: Server login step 1: to KE2 + server_state.

functions.name: cipherbird_opaque_client_finish
functions.doc: Client login step 2: authenticate the server to KE3 + session_key + export_key.

functions.name: cipherbird_opaque_server_finish
functions.doc: Server login step 2: verify KE3 to the session key (error on auth failure).

functions.name: cipherbird_keccak256
functions.doc: Keccak-256 - ORIGINAL Keccak padding (Ethereum). 32-byte output. NOT NIST SHA3-256 (different padding to different digest).

functions.name: cipherbird_ripemd160
functions.doc: RIPEMD-160. 20-byte output. Bitcoin HASH160(x) = ripemd160(sha256(x)).

functions.name: cipherbird_secp256k1_keygen
functions.doc: secp256k1 keypair. sk = 32 bytes; pk = 65 bytes uncompressed (0x04 || X || Y).

functions.name: cipherbird_secp256k1_pubkey
functions.doc: Derive the public key from a 32-byte secret key. compressed: 1 to 33 bytes (0x02/0x03 || X), 0 to 65 bytes (0x04 || X || Y).

functions.name: cipherbird_secp256k1_sign
functions.doc: Sign a 32-byte digest. RFC6979 deterministic nonce, low-S normalized. Returns 65 bytes: r(32) || s(32) || recovery_id(1, value 0..3).

functions.name: cipherbird_secp256k1_verify
functions.doc: Verify. sig is 64 bytes (r || s); pk is 33 or 65 bytes. Low-S enforced. Returns 1 if valid, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: cipherbird_secp256k1_recover
functions.doc: Recover the public key (65-byte uncompressed) from a 32-byte digest and a 65-byte recoverable signature (r || s || recovery_id). Ethereum ecrecover.

functions.name: cipherbird_p256_available
functions.doc: 0 when P-256 is not in this build, 1 when it is, 2 when it is and nonces are deterministic (RFC 6979).

functions.name: cipherbird_p256_keygen
functions.doc: A fresh key pair: secret_key 32 bytes, public_key 65 bytes. Both buffers are NULL when P-256 is not in this build.

functions.name: cipherbird_p256_public_key
functions.doc: The 65-byte public key of a 32-byte secret key; an error for a length other than 32 or a scalar outside 1..n-1.

functions.name: cipherbird_p256_sign
functions.doc: ECDSA over SHA-256(message): 64 bytes, r || s. message may be NULL only with a zero length.

functions.name: cipherbird_p256_verify
functions.doc: 1 when signature (64 bytes, r || s, each in 1..n-1) verifies over SHA-256(message) under public_key (65 bytes, uncompressed, on the curve); 0 for anything else, a wrong length included.

functions.name: cipherbird_p256_import_pkcs8_der
functions.doc: Imports an unencrypted PKCS#8 private key (RFC 5208 PrivateKeyInfo around an RFC 5915 ECPrivateKey), DER. Returns 97 bytes: the secret key (32) followed by its public key (65), which is derived from the scalar. The parse is strict: trailing bytes, a version other than 0, an algorithm other than id-ecPublicKey, a curve other than prime256v1, attributes, an encrypted PKCS#8, a scalar not exactly 32 bytes or outside 1..n-1, an embedded public key that is not the uncompressed point of that scalar, and any indefinite or non-minimal length are all errors. Input is capped at CIPHERBIRD_P256_MAX_PKCS8_BYTES. Wipe the result when done.

functions.name: cipherbird_p256_import_pkcs8_pem
functions.doc: cipherbird_p256_import_pkcs8_der on one PEM block labelled PRIVATE KEY (the .p8 file Apple issues). Only whitespace may surround the block and the body is padded base64; ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY and EC PRIVATE KEY blocks are refused by name. pem need not be NUL-terminated.

functions.name: cipherbird_stego_embed
functions.doc: Embed raw bytes into a media file. Format auto-detected from extension.

functions.name: cipherbird_stego_extract
functions.doc: Extract raw bytes from a stego media file.

functions.name: cipherbird_stego_capacity
functions.doc: Get the steganographic capacity of a cover file (in bytes): the largest payload cipherbird_stego_embed accepts for it. Reported for PPM, BMP, PNG, GIF, JPEG, WAV, MP3 and CRVF, and a nominal figure for MP4; 0 for FLAC and AVI, and 0 when the file cannot be read (missing, truncated or malformed).

functions.name: cipherbird_stego_embed_keyed
functions.doc: Embed with key-derived whitening (+ permutation on .ppm).

functions.name: cipherbird_stego_extract_keyed
functions.doc: Extract a keyed-embedded payload. Wrong key to error (CRC fast-fail).

functions.name: cipherbird_stego_embed_encrypted
functions.doc: AEAD-seal then hide the ciphertext.

functions.name: cipherbird_stego_extract_decrypt
functions.doc: Extract + AEAD-open. Wrong key or tamper to error.

functions.name: cipherbird_physical_seal
functions.doc: Seal `plaintext` (binds `aad`) using `key_media`, hiding it in `cover`.

functions.name: cipherbird_physical_open
functions.doc: Recover: reconstruct keys from `key_media`, extract from `stego`, open.

functions.name: cipherbird_fec_encode
functions.doc: FEC-encode `data` under `scheme`.

functions.name: cipherbird_fec_decode
functions.doc: FEC-decode `original_len` bytes from `data`, correcting within the scheme's bound (Repetition-3: 1 flip per 3-bit group, Repetition-5: 2 per 5-bit group, Hamming(7,4): 1 per 7-bit block). Errs only if `data` is too short. WARNING: past the bound this returns success with WRONG bytes and no error. These are perfect codes: every received group decodes to some codeword, so too many flips are indistinguishable from a correctable error on another codeword and cannot be detected by any decoder. Never treat a successful decode as proof the bytes are right; carry a MAC or AEAD tag inside the payload and verify it after decoding.

functions.name: cipherbird_stego_inspect
functions.doc: Inspect a media file's structural validity + format.

functions.name: cipherbird_stego_content_digest
functions.doc: 32-byte BLAKE2b digest of the whole file - store it, recompute later, and compare with cipherbird_secure_equal to detect ANY change (reference-based tamper detection).

functions.name: cipherbird_stego_detect_hidden
functions.doc: Heuristic hidden-data probe (see caveats above).

functions.name: cipherbird_entropy_assess_file_health
functions.doc: Assess a media file against the SP 800-90B health tests. `max_bytes` caps the sample size; pass 0 for the default (1 MiB). Use BEFORE trusting a file as a deterministic key source.

functions.name: cipherbird_entropy_assess_file_health_v2
functions.doc: Assess a media file under a floor; `max_bytes` 0 means 1 MiB.

functions.name: cipherbird_live_entropy_new
functions.doc: Create a source under a policy (floor in bits per byte, whether the repetition-count test refuses) that seeds after `min_credited_bits` (0 means 256). Free with cipherbird_live_entropy_free.

functions.name: cipherbird_live_entropy_feed
functions.doc: Feed one chunk from logical source `source_id`.

functions.name: cipherbird_live_entropy_generate
functions.doc: Draw `num_bytes` (at most 65536); errs until the first seed is earned.

functions.name: cipherbird_image_factor_seal
functions.doc: Seal `plaintext` (binds `aad`) under OPRF(oprf_secret_seed, reference_image), hiding the ciphertext in `cover`.

functions.name: cipherbird_image_factor_open
functions.doc: Recover: re-derive the keys from the OPRF secret + reference image, extract, AEAD-open. Wrong secret / wrong image / tamper to error.

functions.name: cipherbird_hpke_stego_seal
functions.doc: Seal `plaintext` to recipient public key `pkR`, hiding the ciphertext in `cover`. Returns the PUBLIC KEM encapsulation `enc` - transmit it alongside the carrier (the receiver needs it).

functions.name: cipherbird_hpke_stego_open
functions.doc: Recover: rebuild the session from `enc` + recipient secret `skR`, extract, AEAD-open. Only the holder of skR can.

functions.name: cipherbird_drbg_instantiate
functions.doc: Instantiate from entropy (>=32 B) + optional nonce + optional personalization. Returns NULL on failure (out_error set; free with cipherbird_str_free).

functions.name: cipherbird_drbg_generate
functions.doc: Generate `num_bytes` (<= 65536) pseudo-random bytes, optional additional input.

functions.name: cipherbird_drbg_reseed
functions.doc: Reseed with fresh entropy (>= 32 B, the same floor as instantiate) + optional additional input. Shorter entropy is refused and the state is left unchanged.

functions.name: cipherbird_drbg_free
functions.doc: Free a DRBG handle.

functions.name: cipherbird_fortuna_new
functions.doc: Create a new (unseeded) pool. Free with cipherbird_fortuna_free.

functions.name: cipherbird_fortuna_add_entropy
functions.doc: Add an entropy event from logical source `source_id`.

functions.name: cipherbird_fortuna_generate
functions.doc: Generate `num_bytes`. Errors if the pool has never been seeded.

functions.name: cipherbird_fortuna_reseed
functions.doc: Force a reseed now (folds in the catch-up-scheduled pools).

functions.name: cipherbird_fortuna_reseed_count
functions.doc: Number of reseeds so far (0 = never seeded).

functions.name: cipherbird_fortuna_free
functions.doc: Free a Fortuna handle.

functions.name: cipherbird_keyring_create
functions.doc: Create a keyring with a fresh random master key (unlocked, no slots).

functions.name: cipherbird_keyring_add_device_slot
functions.doc: Add a device slot from a >=32-byte hardware factor key. Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: cipherbird_keyring_add_passphrase_slot
functions.doc: Add a passphrase slot. kdf_preset: 0=interactive, 1=sensitive. Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: cipherbird_keyring_slot_count
functions.doc: Number of slots.

functions.name: cipherbird_keyring_remove_slot
functions.doc: Revoke a slot by index. Returns 1 on success, 0 for a bad index. Works on a locked keyring with no unlock factor, by design: the envelope is an unsigned list of independently sealed slots, so anyone who can write the stored blob can drop a slot anyway. Removal never reveals the master key or adds a way in; removing the last slot makes the master key unrecoverable. Protect the stored envelope (and unlock first in your own flow) when revocation must be an authorised act.

functions.name: cipherbird_keyring_serialise
functions.doc: Serialise the envelope blob (no plaintext key). Caller frees the buffer.

functions.name: cipherbird_keyring_deserialise
functions.doc: Parse an envelope blob into a new (locked) handle. NULL on error.

functions.name: cipherbird_keyring_unlock_with_device
functions.doc: Unlock with a device factor key. Returns the 32-byte master key (caller frees).

functions.name: cipherbird_keyring_add_hardware_slot
functions.doc: Add a hardware slot named by `key_id` (1..255 bytes). Returns the fresh 32-byte factor for the module to wrap (caller frees, which wipes it).

functions.name: cipherbird_keyring_set_hardware_blob
functions.doc: Store the module-wrapped factor (1..4096 bytes) for the hardware slot at `index`. Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: cipherbird_keyring_slot_type
functions.doc: Slot type at `index`: 0 passphrase, 1 device, 2 hardware; -1 for a bad index.

functions.name: cipherbird_keyring_hardware_slot
functions.doc: Key id and module-wrapped factor of the hardware slot at `index`. Both outputs are caller-freed buffers. Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: cipherbird_keyring_unlock_with_hardware
functions.doc: Unlock the hardware slot at `index` with the factor the module unwrapped. Returns the 32-byte master key (caller frees).

functions.name: cipherbird_keyring_unlock_with_passphrase
functions.doc: Unlock with a passphrase. Returns the 32-byte master key (caller frees).

functions.name: cipherbird_keyring_free
functions.doc: Destroy a keyring handle.
